title: Technician charts draw one line per ticked technician and nothing else
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. At least three technicians appear in this location's Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization charts (they have clocked time in the period you look at).
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Set the Technician Efficiency pill to Last 12 Months.
  3. Click View details on the Technician Efficiency tile.
  4. In the Technician filter keep three technicians ticked (any three names in the list).
  5. Count the names in the legend and the distinct coloured lines.
  6. Repeat the last four steps on the Technician Utilization tile.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each chart's legend lists exactly the three ticked technicians and exactly three lines are drawn, one per technician.
  • There is no shop-average, total or other reference line on either chart.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9581 (Story 9, Chart Behavior); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 9. Split out of C88622. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) boards 06_TechEff_After and 07_TechUtil_After, used for on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R7: “A chart draws only the lines its own story defines: one line per selected technician on the technician charts, and one line per advisor on the Billing Efficiency chart (S9-R4). It draws no shop-average line, no aggregate line and no other reference line behind or alongside them. Any additional drawn series is a defect.”
